label: Test ground clearance (m)
description: Test AV origin height above a static surface. Default 0.75 m based on dev.4 visual feedback. Set explicitly; existing saved values are preserved.

label: Spawn test AV
description: Stand on flat, empty ground facing at least 12 m of clear space. Spawns one stationary test vehicle.

label: Open passenger door
description: Requests the physical front-left entrance, not the rear passenger seat.

label: Board as passenger
description: Stand close to the open entrance on clear ground. Uses the native rear-left passenger mount while preserving position for entry animation.

label: Close entrance
description: Requests closing the physical entrance. The door also closes automatically after mounting.

label: Exit as passenger
description: Stationary test: requests native passenger exit only when a valid workspot and exit direction are confirmed. No forced unmount or mod teleport.

label: Inspect vehicle
description: Reports record, clearance, mounting slot, native PSM and workspot/exit-node availability.

label: Remove test AV
description: Exit the AV first. Refuses to delete an occupied vehicle.
